projects.title: Valhalla Vitality
projects.summary: Turned a telehealth pharmacy's manual prescription and follow-up steps into automated, HIPAA-compliant workflows.
projects.description: Built a high-growth online pharmacy platform from the ground up, architecting custom e-commerce logic to handle complex prescription management, compliance tracking, and patient lifecycle workflows. Developed custom CMS templates, checkout flows, and patient portal integrations. Platform supports seamless prescription renewals, educational content delivery, and secure healthcare data management.
projects.problem: A fast-growing online pharmacy needed checkout, prescription management, and patient follow-up to work as one compliant flow. Off-the-shelf e-commerce couldn't model prescriptions, renewals, or compliance tracking.
projects.solution: Designed custom commerce logic that ties each order to prescription management and compliance tracking, then integrated the patient portal for renewals, education content, and automated follow-up care.
projects.outcome: Prescription renewals and follow-up care run as automated workflows instead of manual steps, while patient data stays inside a HIPAA-compliant boundary.
projects.role: Lead developer, delivering this alongside other brands in the Valhalla MSO platform suite.

projects.title: Atlas Premiere Health
projects.summary: Connected a medical practice's existing healthcare systems to a new online pharmacy storefront.
projects.description: Designed and built a custom e-commerce engine on WordPress to bridge an existing medical practice with online pharmacy operations. Architected data synchronization between legacy healthcare systems and modern e-commerce workflows, ensuring real-time inventory management, prescription routing, and patient record integration. Developed custom CMS capabilities for compliance-driven content management.
projects.problem: An established medical practice wanted to expand into online pharmacy sales without running a second, disconnected set of patient, prescription, and inventory records.
projects.solution: Architected a data-sync layer between the practice's EMR/EHR systems and a custom commerce engine, covering real-time inventory, prescription routing, and patient-record integration, plus compliance-driven content management.
projects.outcome: Online orders, inventory, and prescriptions stay in sync with the practice's existing systems, so staff work from one source of truth.
projects.role: Designed and built the commerce engine and integration layer.

projects.title: Spotify for Artists – Co.Lab.Events
projects.summary: Built invite-only RSVPs and audience export to marketing tools for Spotify's in-person artist events.
projects.description: Built on WordPress, this site was responsible for promoting real-world networking events for recording artists. At these events, a panel of industry professionals discuss strategies and tactics to succeed in the music business. The site needed to collect RSVP’s from invitees with a user-unique link, and export audiences into 3rd party marketing tools. As the sole developer on this project, I was responsible for all front-end code, custom WordPress theme, custom plugin, and back-end application logic.
projects.problem: Spotify's artist engagement team ran invite-only networking events for recording artists. They needed RSVPs tied to specific invitees, and attendee lists in their marketing tools.
projects.solution: Built a unique-link invitation and RSVP system with a custom plugin, plus an audience export integration into third-party marketing tools.
projects.outcome: Each event got invitee-specific RSVPs, and attendee audiences flowed straight into Spotify's marketing stack for follow-up.
projects.role: Sole engineer: front end, custom plugin, back-end logic, and integrations.

projects.title: Ironsail AI
projects.summary: Built a white-label templating system that lets non-technical teams launch new brands without engineering help.
projects.description: Built custom responsive design templates adaptable to any brand identity, enabling the company to deliver white-label solutions at scale. Developed custom Visual Composer page builder elements and integrated them into flexible template architecture. Focused on creating reusable component patterns that non-technical teams could configure for diverse client branding requirements.

projects.title: American Ballet Theatre
projects.summary: Migrated decades of historical data from a legacy ASP.NET CMS into a rebuilt platform, intact.
projects.description: As a world-leading classical ballet company, this organization needed an online presence that matched its real-world significance. Its previous platform was a custom ASP.Net CMS, with dozens of data models and decades of historical data. This data needed to be migrated intact into a custom WordPress back-end and rendered into coherent pages for users. My role on the project was integration of custom post types to store the content, custom templates to query data and render it into markup, and front-end integration of layouts, design assets, and user interface.

projects.title: CVS Specialty Expedite
projects.summary: Fed patient sign-ups from a specialty-medication site directly into CRM through third-party APIs.
projects.description: The site’s brand-consistent design needed to reassure patients with unique health challenges. A custom PHP back-end handled submission of user data into 3rd party APIs to facilitate the company’s CRM efforts. My role was development of the PHP back-end with API integration, and responsive design implementation.

projects.title: Oxlumo
projects.summary: Led technical delivery of the patient and HCP sites for an FDA-regulated drug launch on a shared architecture.
projects.description: As one of four products of Alnylam Pharmaceuticals, the importance of accurate, easily accessible drug information can’t be understated. I served as the lead developer, planning a shared system architecture, developed original functionality, design implementation and content integration.

projects.title: Alnylam Assist
projects.summary: Led development of the patient-access site for all four Alnylam products, handling protected health information under HIPAA.
projects.description: The site required robust HIPAA compliance to safely handle protected health information. Regular compliance review was necessary to adhere to FDA advertisement regulations and guidelines. As lead developer, I was responsible for custom theme and module developments, responsive design implementation, and content integration.

projects.title: Trudhesa
projects.summary: Led development of the HCP site for this product launch, built to pass recurring FDA advertising compliance reviews.
projects.description: Regular compliance reviews were necessary to adhere to FDA advertisement regulations and guidelines. As lead developer, I was responsible for custom theme and module developments, responsive design implementation, and content integration.

projects.title: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals
projects.summary: Led major updates to a public company's flagship site and supported the developer team handling content integration and QA.
projects.description: A wide range of objectives and content was accommodated by a custom front end and CMS integration. My role was at times lead developer for several major updates, and supporting a team of developers doing content integration and quality assurance fixes.

projects.title: Medshift
projects.summary: Built the email template system that let a medical-supply retailer's non-technical team run an ambitious campaign schedule on their own.
projects.description: This brand's ambitious email marketing campaign schedule needed to be operated by non-technical associates. My role was to build the custom email templates that would become the basis for the site's email marketing channel.

projects.title: Greater Than One
projects.summary: Owned the agency's flagship site end to end, from functionality and UX to design implementation, as the showcase for its client work and culture.
projects.description: As lead developer on our flagship agency website, I was responsible for all functionality, design implementation, UX, and content integration.

projects.title: Ascender Studios
projects.summary: Built and maintained the studio's one-page showcase site, driven by custom content types and animated layouts.
projects.description: As a developer within the business, showcasing our most impressive work was a critical goal. A one-page-site design was used to display and animate the various content areas. My role was maintaining and developing the one-page design templates driven by CPTs and front-end layouts.
